title: Atom Adventure (Chemistry)
welcome_lead: Today you'll meet the atom — the tiny building block of every element on the periodic table.

concepts.def: Number of protons in the nucleus.
Same element, different number of neutrons.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Every atom is made of protons, neutrons and electrons.

Protons and neutrons sit together in a tiny nucleus. Electrons whizz around it in shells.

Protons are positive, electrons are negative, neutrons are neutral. A neutral atom has the same number of protons and electrons.

The atomic number (Z) is the number of protons. It tells you which element you have. Carbon always has 6 protons.

The mass number (A) is protons + neutrons. So neutrons = A - Z.

Isotopes are atoms of the same element with different numbers of neutrons.

Carbon-12 and carbon-14 both have 6 protons, but carbon-14 has 2 extra neutrons. They behave the same chemically.
